name: Area of Two Circles' Intersection
description: You are given two circles. Find the area of their intersection.
input_specification: The first line contains three integers x 1 , y 1 , r 1 ( - 10 9 ≤ x 1 , y 1 ≤ 10 9 , 1 ≤ r 1 ≤ 10 9 ) — the position of the center and the radius of the first circle. The second line contains three integers x 2 , y 2 , r 2 ( - 10 9 ≤ x 2 , y 2 ≤ 10 9 , 1 ≤ r 2 ≤ 10 9 ) — the position of the center and the radius of the second circle.
output_specification: Print the area of the intersection of the circles. The answer will be considered correct if the absolute or relative error doesn't exceed 10 - 6 .
